intro.title: Hi, I’m {name}
intro.line: Hi, I’m {name}, your guide to Talaan. In two minutes I’ll show you how to run payroll for all your clients, with fewer clicks and fewer mistakes.

home.title: Your home screen
home.line: Every client on one screen. Green means on track, yellow means a deadline is near, and red means something needs you today.

payrun.title: Run payroll in five steps
payrun.line: Pick the client and the cutoff, bring in the hours, let Talaan check them, approve, then get your files. One step per screen, so you always know where you are.

checks.title: Talaan catches mistakes for you
checks.line: Before anything is paid, Talaan checks every employee. Red stops you until it’s fixed. Yellow asks for a short reason. Each message tells you how to fix it.

approve.title: Two people, one approval
approve.line: The person who prepares payroll can’t approve it. The business owner gets a simple summary on their phone and taps Approve. After that, the pay run is locked.

files.title: Every file, named and ready
files.line: Talaan makes the files each office needs, already named and in the right format. A checklist shows where to upload each one and when it’s due. For now you upload them yourself; Talaan reminds you and keeps the receipt.

xero.title: Your books stay in step
xero.line: One click sends the approved payroll to the client’s Xero as a journal. No retyping, and the totals match.

phone.title: Payslips on any phone
phone.line: Employees open their payslip and their BIR Form 2316 on their phone, in English, Tagalog or Chinese. No more printing.

ask.title: Ask Tala, get the source
ask.line: Not sure about a rule? Ask me. I answer from official issuances and show you the source. If I can’t find one, I say so and pass it to your adviser.

language.title: Your language
language.line: Switch between English, Tagalog and Chinese at any time. Terms like SSS and BIR stay the same, so nothing gets lost.

ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.line: That’s Talaan: guided steps, automatic checks, and every file ready. Let’s run your first payroll.

ui.welcome: Payroll and compliance for every client
ui.checkRed: Ana Cruz: SSS number needs 10 digits. You typed 9.
ui.checkAmber: Ben Reyes: net pay is 32% higher than last cutoff.
ui.roleOnlyNote: Jun can’t approve his own pay run
ui.askA: 13th month pay and other benefits are tax-free up to ₱90,000 a year. Only the amount above that is taxed.
